title: Two-point estimates for the logarithmic p-flux of the first Dirichlet p-eigenfunction
summary:
Let \(u>0\) be the first Dirichlet \(p\)-eigenfunction on a bounded convex domain \(Ω\subset\mathbb R^N\), and set \[ X_Ω:=|
abla\log u|^{p-2}
abla\log u. \] We study whether the sharp one-dimensional two-point modulus for \(X_Ω\), which for \(p=2\) reduces to the logarithmic-gradient estimate of Andrews and Clutterbuck, persists for \(p
eq2\). We prove sharp estimates on intervals and balls for every \(p>1\), with the radial modulus on balls strictly larger than the one-dimensional one. In dimensions \(N\ge2\), however, the one-dimensional modulus fails on general convex domains for…
